nodes.name: PortfolioAiAnalyzer.java
nodes.summary: Uses a Spring AI ChatClient to analyze a GitHub repository's metadata and README against a career skill catalog, producing a structured AI-generated project summary.

nodes.name: PortfolioAiAnalyzer
nodes.summary: Component wrapping a ChatClient prompt template to analyze a GitHub project and match it against a student's skill catalog.

nodes.name: analyzeGithubProject
nodes.summary: Builds an AI prompt from a repo's README and skill catalog, invokes the chat model, and returns a structured AiGithubSummary with matched skills and tech stack.

nodes.name: GithubApiClient.java
nodes.summary: REST client wrapper around the GitHub API for fetching repository metadata and raw file contents (e.g., README) using an optional bearer token.

nodes.name: GithubApiClient
nodes.summary: Component that calls the GitHub REST API to retrieve repository metadata and raw file content with authenticated headers.

nodes.name: getRepoMetadata
nodes.summary: Calls the GitHub repos API for a given owner/repo and parses the JSON response into a GithubRepoMetadata record, handling errors gracefully.

nodes.name: fetchFileContent
nodes.summary: Fetches raw file content (e.g., README) from a GitHub raw URL and truncates it to a maximum length.

nodes.name: GithubPortfolioController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller exposing an endpoint to import a portfolio project from a GitHub repository URL.

nodes.name: importFromGithub
nodes.summary: Handles a request to import a GitHub repository into the authenticated student's portfolio, delegating to GithubPortfolioService.

nodes.name: PortfolioController.java
nodes.summary: REST controller for the authenticated student's own portfolio: retrieving, upserting configuration/projects/education, and requesting mentor review.

nodes.name: getPortfolio
nodes.summary: Returns the authenticated student's full portfolio.

nodes.name: upsertPortfolio
nodes.summary: Creates or updates the authenticated student's portfolio configuration, projects, and education from a request payload.

nodes.name: requestReview
nodes.summary: Submits a mentor review request for the student's portfolio, identified by mentor email.

nodes.name: PublicPortfolioController.java
nodes.summary: Public-facing REST controller for viewing a student's portfolio by slug or student ID, without authentication.

nodes.name: getPortfolioBySlug
nodes.summary: Retrieves a public portfolio by its slug.

nodes.name: getPortfolioByStudentId
nodes.summary: Retrieves a public portfolio by student ID.

nodes.name: GithubImportRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the GitHub repository URL to import as a portfolio project.

nodes.name: PortfolioUpsertRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO aggregating a portfolio's configuration, projects, and education entries for create/update operations.

nodes.name: RequestReviewRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying the mentor's email address for a portfolio review request.

nodes.name: UpdateSlugRequest.java
nodes.summary: Request DTO carrying a new portfolio slug value.

nodes.name: PortfolioResponse.java
nodes.summary: Response DTO aggregating a student's user info, portfolio configuration, skills, projects, and education for API output.

nodes.name: PortfolioConfig.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity storing a student's portfolio visual configuration (theme, colors, fonts, hero and skills section content) with automatic timestamp management.

nodes.name: prePersist
nodes.summary: JPA lifecycle hook that sets created/updated timestamps before initial persist.

nodes.name: preUpdate
nodes.summary: JPA lifecycle hook that refreshes the updated timestamp before an update.

nodes.name: PortfolioProject.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity representing a project showcased in a student's portfolio, including repo URL, demo URL, description, stars, and tech stack.

nodes.name: StudentEducation.java
nodes.summary: JPA entity representing a student's education history entry (university, degree, period, description) shown on their portfolio.

nodes.name: PortfolioMapper.java
nodes.summary: Maps between portfolio domain entities and DTOs, converting user/student/config/skills/projects/education data into a PortfolioResponse and converting request DTOs into entity lists.

nodes.name: PortfolioMapper
nodes.summary: Component that converts portfolio-related entities into response DTOs and request DTOs into entities, resolving skill names via SkillRepository.

nodes.name: toPortfolioResponse
nodes.summary: Builds a full PortfolioResponse from user, student, config, skills, projects, and education domain objects, resolving skill names by lookup.

nodes.name: toPortfolioProjects
nodes.summary: Converts a list of project request DTOs into PortfolioProject entities linked to the given user.

nodes.name: toStudentEducationList
nodes.summary: Converts a list of education request DTOs into StudentEducation entities linked to the given student.

nodes.name: PortfolioConfigRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for PortfolioConfig, providing lookup by user ID.

nodes.name: PortfolioProjectRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for PortfolioProject, providing lookup and deletion by user ID.

nodes.name: StudentEducationRepository.java
nodes.summary: Spring Data repository for StudentEducation, providing lookup and deletion by user ID.

nodes.name: GithubPortfolioService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining the contract for importing a GitHub repository as a portfolio project.

nodes.name: PortfolioService.java
nodes.summary: Service interface defining the contract for portfolio retrieval (by user, slug, student ID), upsert, and mentor review requests.

nodes.name: GithubPortfolioServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements GithubPortfolioService by parsing a GitHub URL, fetching repo metadata and README via GithubApiClient, running AI analysis via PortfolioAiAnalyzer, and recording matched skill evidence.

nodes.name: GithubPortfolioServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Service implementation orchestrating GitHub repo parsing, metadata/README fetching, AI project analysis, and skill evidence recording for portfolio imports.

nodes.name: importFromGithub
nodes.summary: Parses a GitHub repo URL, fetches metadata and README content, runs AI analysis against the student's career skill catalog, records matched skill evidence, and returns a portfolio project response.

nodes.name: PortfolioServiceImpl.java
nodes.summary: Implements PortfolioService: assembles and returns portfolios by user/slug/student ID, and upserts portfolio config, projects, and education via repository sync methods, plus mentor review request creation.

nodes.name: PortfolioServiceImpl
nodes.summary: Service implementation that assembles portfolio responses from multiple repositories and manages create/update operations for portfolio config, projects, education, and review requests.

nodes.name: getPortfolio
nodes.summary: Assembles the authenticated student's portfolio by fetching user, config, skills, projects, and education, then mapping to a response.

nodes.name: getPortfolioBySlug
nodes.summary: Assembles and returns a portfolio response for a student looked up by portfolio slug.

nodes.name: getPortfolioByStudentId
nodes.summary: Assembles and returns a portfolio response for a student looked up by student ID.

nodes.name: upsertPortfolio
nodes.summary: Creates or updates the student's portfolio config, projects, and education from a request, then returns the refreshed portfolio.

nodes.name: requestReview
nodes.summary: Validates the mentor by email, prevents duplicate pending requests, and creates a PortfolioReviewRequest linking student and mentor.

nodes.name: syncPortfolioConfig
nodes.summary: Finds or creates the student's PortfolioConfig and updates its theme, colors, fonts, and section content from the request, then saves it.

nodes.name: syncPortfolioProjects
nodes.summary: Replaces the user's portfolio projects by deleting existing ones and saving the newly mapped set.

nodes.name: syncPortfolioEducation
nodes.summary: Replaces the student's education entries by deleting existing ones and saving the newly mapped set.
